title: TV tells Auto-layout players to hold GO
body: Summary: lobby step 3 said 'Hold GO. Find the first corner.' and the countdown dial said HOLD GO, while the phone (Auto layout is the default since 8f211d0f) has no GO button and says 'GO is automatic'. Flow: pair, lobby, countdown. Expected impact: the first instruction a new player reads is false. Evaluation: step 3 is now 'Drive'; the countdown cue reads the claimed seats' layouts (GET READY unless a pedal-layout seat or keyboard needs HOLD GO).

title: Lobby slogans restate the second-driver line and the phone counter
body: Summary: 'TWO PHONES. ONE CIRCUIT.' sat top right on every menu and 'No app needed. Two phone seats.' under the PIN; the footer already says PLAYER 2 / SCAN TO JOIN and the panel shows n / 2 PHONES CONNECTED. Evaluation: both removed; the status slot carries only a notice or PREPARING CIRCUIT.

title: Focused buttons use the remote's key name, the phone uses a verb
body: Summary: SELECT / PRACTICE, SELECT / REMATCH, SELECT / RACE NEXT ROUND, SELECT CLAIM / DOWN RACE vs phone START RACE and RACE NEXT ROUND. Career footer hints were mixed case and omitted DOWN. Evaluation: buttons are the verb only, centred on their bar via GlyphLayer.width (no per-frame cost, runs in the 10 Hz rebuild); hints in KEY  ACTION capitals.

title: HULL vs HP, OVERHEAT vs OVERHEATED, COOL vs COOLING
body: Summary: the race HUD labelled health HULL while its own footer and the phone say HP; weapon states OVERHEAT / COOL 2s where the phone says OVERHEATED / COOLING. Evaluation: one name each (ability COOL n s already matches the phone and is unchanged).

title: Seat is P1 / P2 / SECOND DRIVER / PLAYER n
body: Summary: footer and lobby car panel said P1, P2, SECOND DRIVER while race strip, results and phone say PLAYER n. Evaluation: PLAYER n everywhere on the TV.

title: Results name themselves twice; receipt buries what was banked behind DEBT + CAP
body: Summary: header RACE RESULTS plus panel THE FINISH; garage header PARTS / PER CAR duplicated THE GARAGE; the receipt led with PRIZE / PIT / DEBT + CAP and put BANKED second. Evaluation: panel says RESULTS, header shows the course line like the lobby; BANKED +n CR leads, arithmetic is a quiet second line in the phone's words (REPAYMENTS + CAP).

title: Garage bar SELECT: TIER, link banner LINK QUIET, sound hint names a state, feel id trails BACK
body: Summary: phone says INSTALL; phone now says 'Link lost'; M / Y: SOUND ON named a state the key flips; 'BACK: LOBBY / feel' showed a lobby-only setting in garage and career. Evaluation: INSTALL TIER n / price CR, LINK LOST, M / Y  MUTE | SOUND ON, BACK: LOBBY.

title: Key hints in three forms
body: Summary: UP  /  CAREER, LEFT / RIGHT: CAR, LEFT-RIGHT Reward vs lobby row KEY  ACTION. Evaluation: one form, pinned by test.

title: PR and CR are unexplained jargon on both screens
body: Summary: rivals show 'PR 120 / 800 CR / GRUDGE'; footer shows '120 CR'. PR (power rating) is never defined; CR reads as a currency only to people who already know. Phone market uses the same shorthand. Proposal: one name each decided with the phone (e.g. a car icon + number for power, a coin icon + number for credits).
gate: needs icon art from art context

title: Phone says 'hold GO' / 'release GO' in Auto where GO has no button (controller seam)
body: Summary: controller status 'Linked · hold GO again' (after reconnect) and 'TV paused · release GO' are shown to Auto-layout players who have no GO to hold. Needs the controller context: say 'Linked' / 'TV paused' when layout.autoThrottle. TV side has no paused screen at all (RaceGame.pause() only sets server.paused); a TV 'PAUSED' tile would match the phone's message.
evidence: controller/index.html (ack handler 'Linked · hold GO again'; tvPaused status 'TV paused · release GO'); RaceGame.kt:347

title: Ability phase WINDUP (phone) vs WIND-UP (TV); INSTALL n vs INSTALL TIER n (controller seam)
body: Summary: phone prints ab.phase raw (WINDUP, RECOVERY) where TV prints WIND-UP, RECOVERING; phone garage button INSTALL 2 / 300 CR has a bare tier number. Align the phone to the TV words (controller owns the strings).

title: Garage and results have no picture of the thing being discussed
body: Summary: garage lists parts as words with before > after stat text beside bars (numbers twice); the car itself is not on screen (the lobby shows it). Results is six text rows with no podium or car sprites. Proposal: car sprite large in garage with stat bars changing live, delta chips only on the selected part; results podium of three car sprites with the other three as small rows. Shop/save line 'Parts stay with this car / New profile' is internal jargon (RaceGame.kt:108-109,822).
gate: screenshot walk, perf pair for added sprites

title: Pairing: TV code is the focal point, QR beside it, one line
body: Round 2. TV CODE in the title font beside the QR (phone says TV code; PIN gone on the TV); three steps became one line.

title: Career script caption hid debt meter, debt/next-unlock lines and course preview
body: Round 2. Every career element has a rect (CareerLayout); the caption box sits in the free band under the progress bar; a test proves no intersection.

title: Career screen: a picture and one line per element
body: Round 2. Story paragraph, objective, unlock line, PAID/PR/CR and difficulty description removed from the TV (phone career sheet keeps them); round, title, course line, debt+meter, pills, button, one hint row, rival name+car+tag remain. Same commit as tv-12 because both rewrite the same rects.

title: Race HUD: numbers, icons and bars instead of labels; duplicate strip removed
body: Round 2. Ammo numbers beside icons, state words only when not READY, ability name/ENERGY gone, bottom strip gone unless PREPARING/WRECKED, footer HP text replaced by a thin bar. Left for a later round: big-digit position/lap/speed are still captioned by words (POSITION, LAP, KM/H) because no icon art exists for them; the HUD static-layer card is still open.
gate: :game:test exit 0 (no Stick perf pair, not screenshot-verified)

title: No Wi-Fi / Port busy hidden behind the phone count; hud weaponStates lack core state
body: Seams from link and core: pairStatus shows serverStatus when noNetwork; weaponStatesJson adds state from Combat.weaponStatus.
